_note: v2 hooks for Caserne des Pompiers (B63_pompiers): hook wording matched to the painted details in pompiers/pompiers.jpg.

fr_solution_noun.hook: Like English 'solution', said soh-lew-SYOHN: a firefighter finds the SOLUTION: a trampoline at the foot of the pole.
fr_solution_noun.why: In pompiers/pompiers.jpg the round red rescue trampoline sits directly at the base of the brass fireman's pole.

fr_faute_noun.hook: Like English 'fault', said FOHT: a clumsy firefighter's boot pours water into the bucket, his own FAULT, and the black cat glares like a FOE.
fr_faute_noun.why: In pompiers/pompiers.jpg the firefighter empties water out of his wet boot into the tin bucket while the black cat glares beside the spill.

fr_danger_noun.hook: Like English 'danger', said dahn-ZHAY: firefighter DAN spots DANGER: a blue JAY by the station's bell rope.
fr_danger_noun.why: In pompiers/pompiers.jpg firefighter Dan holds the rescued blue jay on his gloved hand right beside the hanging bell rope and wall bell.

fr_incendie_noun.hook: Like English 'incendiary', said an-sahn-DEE: firefighters train their hoses on a burning barn while the cow watches safely behind the fence. Un incendie is a big FIRE; a campfire is un feu.
fr_incendie_noun.why: In pompiers/pompiers.jpg two firefighters spray water onto the burning wooden barn prop while the spotted cow watches safely behind the low wooden fence.
